Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue improve?
Choices:
A. A specific reusable workflow, such as clarify, plan, implement, review_autofix, orchestrate or validate. Name it in your `/answer`. (RECOMMENDED)
B. A specific script or helper under `scripts/`. Give the path in your `/answer`.
C. Documentation (README.md, `docs/`, or the agents.md fragments).
D. Something else. Describe it in your `/answer`.
Q2: What kind of improvement do you want?
Choices:
A. Fix a specific bug or failure you have seen. Include the run link, PR/issue number or error text. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Make it faster or cut cost (runtime, runner slots, API calls, tokens).
C. Make it more reliable (retries, recovery, fewer stuck states).
D. Add a new capability or behaviour. Describe what it should do.
E. Make the documentation or operator experience clearer.
Q3: How will we know the change worked?
Choices:
A. A specific failure no longer happens, for example a named run or error stops recurring. (RECOMMENDED)
B. A measurable target is met, for example "runtime under N minutes" or "fewer than N API calls per cycle". Give the number in your `/answer`.
C. A new contract test proving the new behaviour passes.
